Test Steps: Verify Admin can create a new Training Module
Test Data: 1. Log in as Admin 2. Go to Training > Modules 3. Click 'Add Module' 4. Fill Title, Description, Duration, Trainer 5. Save
Date of execution: Training module is successfully created and status is Active.

Test Steps: Verify validation when mandatory fields are left blank
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Module' 2. Leave 'Title' and 'Trainer' blank 3. Save
Date of execution: System displays validation error indicating missing mandatory fields.

Test Steps: Verify validation for invalid Training Duration format
Test Data: 1. Enter Duration as 'ABC' or negative number 2. Save
Date of execution: System blocks creation with 'Duration must be a positive number' error.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can upload Training Material (PDF/MP4)
Test Data: 1. Open Training Module 2. Click 'Add Material' 3. Upload a 5MB PDF and a 50MB MP4 Video
Date of execution: Files upload successfully and are attached to the module syllabus.

Test Steps: Verify validation when uploading unsupported file format
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Material' 2. Upload an executable file (.exe)
Date of execution: System rejects upload and prompts 'Only PDF/Video/Image files allowed'.

Test Steps: Verify validation when file size exceeds server limit
Test Data: 1. Upload a 1GB video file (assuming limit is 500MB)
Date of execution: System rejects upload with 'File size exceeds maximum limit' error.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can bulk enroll Employees into a Training Module
Test Data: 1. Open Module 2. Click 'Enroll Employees' 3. Select Department 'IT' 4. Save
Date of execution: All IT employees are enrolled and receive a notification.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can self-enroll into an open/optional Training
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee 2. Go to Available Trainings 3. Click 'Enroll' on an optional module
Date of execution: Employee is enrolled, and module appears in 'My Trainings' list.

Test Steps: Verify validation when Employee attempts to enroll in an expired/closed Training
Test Data: 1. Attempt to enroll in a Training with 'Closed' status
Date of execution: System hides the 'Enroll' button or returns 'Training is no longer active' error.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can mark a Chapter/Material as Read
Test Data: 1. Open Enrolled Module 2. Read Chapter 1 3. Click 'Mark as Completed'
Date of execution: Chapter is marked completed and overall progress bar updates (e.g. 25%).

Test Steps: Verify validation when Employee attempts to mark Quiz as completed without taking it
Test Data: 1. Click 'Mark as Completed' on a Quiz chapter without submitting the quiz form
Date of execution: System blocks action with 'You must pass the quiz to complete this section'.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can submit a Quiz and pass
Test Data: 1. Open Quiz 2. Answer questions correctly 3. Submit
Date of execution: System grades quiz instantly, marks it as 'Passed' (if score > passing marks).

Test Steps: Verify Employee failing a Quiz must retake it
Test Data: 1. Answer questions incorrectly 2. Submit
Date of execution: System marks it as 'Failed' and prompts 'Retake Quiz' (if retakes allowed).

Test Steps: Verify Quiz Timer auto-submits when time expires
Test Data: 1. Start a 5-minute timed quiz 2. Wait for 5 minutes
Date of execution: System automatically submits the currently selected answers when timer hits 0:00.

Test Steps: Verify System generates a Certificate upon 100% course completion
Test Data: 1. Employee completes all chapters and passes the final quiz
Date of execution: System automatically generates a downloadable PDF Certificate of Completion.

Test Steps: Verify validation preventing Certificate generation for incomplete courses
Test Data: 1. Complete only 90% of the course 2. Look for Certificate download link
Date of execution: Download link is hidden/disabled until progress reaches 100%.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can submit Feedback for the Trainer/Module
Test Data: 1. Complete Training 2. Fill feedback form (Rating 1-5 & Comments) 3. Submit
Date of execution: Feedback is saved securely, visible to HR/Admin to assess trainer quality.

Test Steps: Verify Employee A cannot view Employee B's Quiz scores
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee A 2. Modify URL parameter to view Employee B's result ID
Date of execution: System blocks access and shows '403 Unauthorized' error.

Test Steps: Verify XSS payload in Training Feedback Comments
Test Data: 1. Submit feedback 2. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> in comments
Date of execution: System sanitizes the input ensuring no malicious scripts are executed on Admin dashboard.

Test Steps: Verify SQL Injection in Search Training input
Test Data: 1. Go to Training Catalog 2. Enter SQL payload in search bar
Date of execution: System handles query safely and returns 'No courses found' without throwing DB errors.
